_devices: Order matters within a domain: the first writable member is preferred as representative.
_pixel: Enabled 2026-09-01: same zero-root plain-adb tier phone/tab use, works exactly like them once wireless adb is armed. Plan on a manual USB re-arm (adb -d tcpip 5555, <software>\Phone\Pixel\rearm_wireless_adb.bat) after every cold start, since it has no non-root path to a persistent pairing the way phone/tab do (Android's Wireless Debugging pairing doesn't exist before Android 11, and this device's final OS version is Android 10) -- a clean reboot test the same day saw it come back with zero re-arm needed, cause not identified (see ARCHITECTURE.md's Sec 8 anomaly note), so this is a possible bonus, not a guarantee to build on. Until re-armed after a reboot, this entry just sits unreachable and the daemon retries with its normal backoff, harmless. Send Clip (the installed android_app/) still exists as a same-day fallback for a moment it hasn't been re-armed yet, confirmed working with zero manual app-opening after a clean reboot. The real ClipBridge crash once found on this device (BUG-009) is fixed and stays in the codebase.
_domains: Devices that already mirror each other by themselves. CopyClip writes to ONE member and lets Samsung Continuity distribute internally; it never syncs phone to tab itself. grace_s is how long Continuity gets to propagate before a probe counts as missed.
_images: allow_images defaults false (fail-safe) until real-use verification per bugs/SPIKE-IMAGE-CLIPBOARD.md's open Q5/Q7 is confirmed. max_image_bytes is independently enforced on both the laptop (core/policy.py) and each device (android/ClipBridge.java's own MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) -- belt and braces, not just one check.
_screenshot_backup: Stopgap for a Windows 11 25H2 Snipping Tool bug: having both its own "automatically save" and "automatically copy" settings on double-writes the clipboard (see ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Two entries in Windows Clipboard History' note). With Windows' own auto-save turned off to fix that, this replicates the local file save instead -- for screenshots taken on the laptop AND, via screenshot_backup_include_devices, ones taken on the phone/tablet that sync here. Empty dir disables both. Remove once Microsoft fixes the underlying bug and Windows' own setting is safe to re-enable.
_screenshot_exclude_from_history: A large device-synced image was observed evicting other entries from Windows Clipboard History (Win+V) -- see bugs/BUG-005's Open points. Excluding it from History fixes that, at the cost of the synced image itself never appearing in the Win+V list (Ctrl+V still pastes it correctly either way -- this only affects History's own bookkeeping, not the live clipboard). Set to false to go back to showing synced images in Win+V history and accept the occasional eviction of other entries.
_push_port: Hub-side listener for the 'Send Clip' manual fallback (transports/push_listener.py) -- a device dials IN here instead of the hub polling it, for devices background sync cannot reach (pixel). Same copyclip.key, mutual HMAC handshake either direction.
_adopt_on_connect: false keeps a reconnect from overwriting what you just copied on the laptop with the device's older clip.
